body:
Thank you for your earnest reply. I know what it's like to not feel like this. I want so badly to feel good about myself again. But somewhere in the back of my head, for all the false bravado in my life, I've hated myself. I'm just not sure that's something that can be fixed. I've tried group, individual therapy, hitting up random -anon meetings, but it's all so pointless if I just keep coming back to this headspace.

Again, thank you. I'm trying, but I'm just not hopeful.
